categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Matches the P2P label and modifies connection management logic in src/net.cpp.
categories.rationale: Fixes peer discovery failure by preventing ThreadOpenConnections from draining seednodes and addr-fetch queues while network activity is disabled. As described in the PR, when networkactive is toggled off, seednodes are popped and permanently discarded by OpenNetworkConnection refusing dials, leaving the node unable to bootstrap without a restart once the network is re-enabled.
